title: The Bird in Pieces
paras: Mina was a [[housewife|housewife]] who painted plates at her kitchen table. For a small art show, she painted a blue bird on a white [[dish|dish]]. Its wings pointed up, and its head turned towards the sun. Mina was [[quite|quite]] pleased with it. But the night before the show, her cat knocked it onto the floor. It broke into seven pieces. Mina sat down and looked at them sadly.

Her neighbour Tomas, a sixteen-year-old [[teenager|teenager]], came to help. He liked making pictures from old things. They could not make the plate smooth again. “Let's make a wall picture [[instead|instead]],” he said. He found a square piece of wood painted white. Mina moved the broken pieces around until the bird faced a new [[direction|direction]], towards the left. Tomas weighed twenty [[gram|grams]] of special glue, and Mina carefully fixed each piece to the wood.

By morning, the glue was dry. The spaces between the pieces looked like bright lines around the bird. At the show, the [[owner|owner]] of a little art shop stopped to look. “What an [[amazing|amazing]] idea!” she said. She offered to put the picture in her shop window. Back home, Mina shared a bag of [[cookie|cookies]] with Tomas. Her broken bird had found a new home.
zh: 米娜是一位家庭主妇，平时在厨房的桌子上画装饰盘。为了参加一个小型艺术展，她在一个白盘子上画了一只蓝鸟。鸟的翅膀朝上，头转向太阳。米娜对它相当满意。然而，展览前一天晚上，她的猫把盘子碰到了地上。盘子碎成了七块。米娜坐下来，难过地看着这些碎片。
她的邻居、十六岁的少年托马斯过来帮忙。他喜欢用旧东西拼画。他们无法让盘子重新变得平整。“不如把它做成一幅挂画吧，”他说。他找来一块涂成白色的方形木板。米娜移动碎片的位置，直到鸟转向一个新的方向——左边。托马斯称出二十克专用胶水，米娜小心地把每块碎片固定在木板上。
到了早上，胶水干了。碎片之间的空隙看起来像鸟儿周围一道道明亮的线条。在展览上，一家小艺术品店的店主停下来看这幅画。“这个主意真妙！”她说。她提出把画放在自己的商店橱窗里。回家后，米娜和托马斯分享了一袋曲奇饼。她那只破碎的鸟找到了新家。

q.s: The plate was damaged one evening before the exhibition.
q.why: 盘子在展览前一天晚上被猫碰碎。

q.s: The special glue cost five pounds.
q.why: 文中说明了胶水用量，未说明价格。

q.s: The shop owner offered to put the picture in her home rather than her shop window.
q.why: 店主提议放在商店橱窗里，而非家中。
